text:
maria: Quick design question  I pushed a small update to the Console list view: swapping the 'Grid' toggle label to 'Tiles' and increasing the gap between items to token space-6. Preview at 1280px looks way cleaner. anyone opposed?

devon: looks better. minor concern: routes table cell truncation on narrower screens. can we ensure long route names wrap?

lee: i'll test wrap behavior at 1024 and 768. in theory the increased gap shouldn't affect table cells but need to confirm.

anya: copy nit: 'Tiles' matches other places. good to standardize. also tooltip should read "Toggle to tiles view" not "Toggle to grid view".

sam: Accessibility: when switching views, ensure focus order remains identical. focus should not jump to the first tile.

maria: good catch. plan: preserve DOM order and only toggle visual layout classes to avoid focus jumps.

design-bot: figma link updated: https://figma.com/file/xyz-tile-toggle  diff created.

devon: about tokens: rather than renaming space-6, can we add alias --rdw-gap-tiles that maps to spacing.space-6 so teams can theme easily?

lee: i'll include CSS variable in PR and add an alias in tokens file. also adding a snapshot test to catch regressions.

anya: one more tiny thing: the toggle's aria-label should be "Switch to tiles view" and when active "Tiles view, activated". helps screen readers.

maria: updated aria-labels in Figma and will reflect in the component. i'll also add a note in the changelog.

devon: sounds good. after the PR lands we should run a quick smoke-test on the staging console to validate breakpoints.

maria: PR is up: #1267. includes token alias, aria-label fix, focus-preservation approach, and snapshots. cc @devon @lee for review.

sam: :thumbsup: will run the smoke after merge.

design-bot: PR 1267 created by maria with changeset and storybook snapshot update.
